description:
Run Python in the current checkout with the Locus Python SDK ready to use. The selected runtime from Settings > General is used, and `locus`, `project`, and `workspace_ref` are injected into an async body, so top-level `await` works.

Common SDK calls:
- Status: `status = await locus.get_unity_editor_status(project=project)`; inspect `status.process_state`, `status.ready`, `status.main_thread_blocked`, `status.blocking_reason`, `status.blocking_dialog`, `status.blocking_dialog_recoverable`, and `status.is_crashed`
- Start/reconnect: `result = await locus.ensure_unity_editor(project=project, mode="interactive", wait_until="ready")`
- Headless start: `result = await locus.ensure_unity_editor(project=project, mode="headless", wait_until="ready")`
- Restart: `result = await locus.restart_unity_editor(project=project, mode="interactive", wait_until="ready")`; inspect `result.forced_process_ids` and `result.status`
- Tool call: `result = await locus.call_tool("unity_get_console_log", {"limit": 50}, workspace_ref=workspace_ref)`

Status fields report observable state and capabilities; the model chooses whether to resolve a dialog, wait, or restart Unity. Use action=`help` only when a workflow needs more SDK surface. Topics: `agents`, `sessions`, `tools`, `unity`, `callbacks`. This keeps advanced documentation out of the default context. For action=`run`, set readonly=true only when the Python body and every SDK/tool call it makes are observation-only.

action.description: Run Python code, or progressively load one SDK help topic. Default run.

code.description: Python statements executed inside an async function. `locus`, `project`, and `workspace_ref` are already defined; top-level await is supported. Required for action=run.

topic.description: SDK documentation topic returned by action=help. Default overview.

readonly.description: Whether the Python body and all nested SDK/tool calls only observe state. Required for action=run; help is always read-only.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for sync execution. Default 120000; maximum 1800000. Background async/notify execution has no deadline.
